cards.title: always
cards.desc:
I always wash my hands before eating.
提示：always = 总是；al 读作 /ɔːl/。

cards.title: around
cards.desc:
The dog runs around the tree.
提示：around = 在……周围；发音类似“呃-绕nd”。

cards.title: because
cards.desc:
I stayed home because I was sick.
提示：because = 因为；中间的 eau 读作 /ɪˈkəz/。

cards.title: been
cards.desc:
I have been to the park.
提示：been = 已经；常读作 /bɪn/。

cards.title: before
cards.desc:
Wash your hands before lunch.
提示：before = 在……以前；be 读作 /bɪ/。

cards.title: best
cards.desc:
You did your best today.
提示：best = 最好的；字母 e 发短音 /ɛ/。

cards.title: both
cards.desc:
Both birds are in the tree.
提示：both = 两者都；字母组合 th 读作 /θ/。

cards.title: buy
cards.desc:
I will buy a new book.
提示：buy = 买；u 不发通常的短音，整体认读。

cards.title: call
cards.desc:
Please call me after school.
提示：call = 打电话；字母组合 all 中的 a 读作 /ɔː/。

cards.title: cold
cards.desc:
My hands are cold.
提示：cold = 冷的；字母 o 读长音 /oʊ/。

cards.title: does
cards.desc:
Does she like apples?
提示：does = 做；常读作 /dʌz/，不是按字母拼读。

cards.title: don't
cards.desc:
I don't want to go yet.
提示：don't = 不；撇号表示 do 和 not 的缩写。

cards.title: fast
cards.desc:
The rabbit runs fast.
提示：fast = 快的；a 发短音 /æ/。

cards.title: first
cards.desc:
I came first in the race.
提示：first = 第一；ir 读作 /ɜːr/。

cards.title: five
cards.desc:
I can count to five.
提示：five = 五；结尾 e 不发音，i 发长音 /aɪ/。

cards.title: found
cards.desc:
We found a shell on the beach.
提示：found = 找到；ou 读作 /aʊ/。

cards.title: gave
cards.desc:
Dad gave me a warm hug.
提示：gave = 给了；结尾 e 不发音，a 发长音 /eɪ/。

cards.title: goes
cards.desc:
She goes to school by bus.
提示：goes = 去；词尾 oes 读作 /oʊz/。

cards.title: green
cards.desc:
The grass is green.
提示：green = 绿色的；ee 通常读长音 /iː/。

cards.title: its
cards.desc:
The cat licked its paw.
提示：its = 它的；注意 its 没有撇号。

cards.title: made
cards.desc:
Mom made a cake.
提示：made = 制作了；结尾 e 不发音，a 发长音 /eɪ/。

cards.title: many
cards.desc:
Many children play outside.
提示：many = 许多；a 发短音 /ɛ/。

cards.title: off
cards.desc:
Please take your shoes off.
提示：off = 离开；字母 o 发短音 /ɔ/。

cards.title: or
cards.desc:
Would you like milk or water?
提示：or = 或者；常读作 /ɔːr/。

cards.title: pull
cards.desc:
Please pull the door open.
提示：pull = 拉；字母组合 u 读作 /ʊ/。

cards.title: read
cards.desc:
I read a book every night.
提示：读；过去式和现在式拼写相同。

cards.title: right
cards.desc:
Turn right at the corner.
提示：右边；字母组合 igh 发长音 /ī/。

cards.title: sing
cards.desc:
We sing a happy song.
提示：唱歌。

cards.title: sit
cards.desc:
Please sit on the chair.
提示：坐；字母 i 发短音 /ĭ/。

cards.title: sleep
cards.desc:
The baby is ready to sleep.
提示：睡觉；字母组合 ee 发长音 /ē/。

cards.title: tell
cards.desc:
Please tell me a story.
提示：告诉。

cards.title: their
cards.desc:
Their dog is very small.
提示：他们的；表示所属关系。

cards.title: these
cards.desc:
These apples are red.
提示：这些；指离说话人较近的多个东西。

cards.title: those
cards.desc:
Those birds are in the tree.
提示：那些；指离说话人较远的多个东西。

cards.title: upon
cards.desc:
Upon the hill stood a tall tree.
提示：在……上；较正式的“在……上面”。

cards.title: us
cards.desc:
Please wait for us.
提示：我们；宾格形式，用在动词或介词后。

cards.title: use
cards.desc:
Use a pencil to draw.
提示：使用；字母 u 在这里发长音 /ū/。

cards.title: very
cards.desc:
The soup is very hot.
提示：非常；用来加强语气。

cards.title: wash
cards.desc:
Wash your hands before lunch.
提示：洗；字母组合 sh 发 /sh/ 音。

cards.title: which
cards.desc:
Which color do you like?
提示：哪一个；用来提问选择。

cards.title: why
cards.desc:
Why are you smiling?
提示：为什么；用来询问原因。

cards.title: wish
cards.desc:
I wish for a new book.
提示：希望；字母组合 sh 发 /sh/ 音。

cards.title: work
cards.desc:
We work together at school.
提示：工作；字母组合 or 发 /ər/ 音。

cards.title: would
cards.desc:
I would like some water.
提示：将会；常缩写为 would like，表示“想要”。

cards.title: write
cards.desc:
Please write your name.
提示：写；字母组合 wr 中的 w 不发音。

cards.title: your
cards.desc:
Where is your backpack?
提示：你的；表示所属关系。
